title: Introducing the Swift: A New Dimension to Explore in Minecraft
summary: Explore the Swift, our free, fan-made Minecraft Sift mod for Java and Bedrock, with six biomes, 15 mobs, three bosses, and shifting tides.
body_markdown:
We built a whole new world, and you can step into it today.


Introducing **the Swift** : CreativeMode’s independent, fan-made take on the Sift, Minecraft’s newly announced dimension. We recreated our interpretation with CreativeMode, and it’s available now as a **free download for Java 26.1, Java 26.3, and Bedrock 1.26.50 or newer** .


Beyond the Deep Dark portal, you’ll find pink meadows, towering white willows, rainbow ichor, unfamiliar creatures, and a sky that tells you when the rules are about to change. There are places to settle, strange things to build with, and bosses waiting for anyone ready to go looking.
